[[Sakutila]] can be found in the western chamber of the [[Halls of Chokhin]].

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}} (inside the Halls of Chokhin)

==Dialogue==
:''"This library is wonderful. You can find out so many interesting things here. For instance, I'm trying to determine who would win in a fight between [[Spearmarshal Kormir|Kormir]] and [[Turai Ossa]]. Ooh. How about [[Palawa Joko]] versus [[Lady Glaive]]? So many potential battles."  ''

==Notes==
*This appears to be one of the NPCs named over posters of Guild Wars Online (one of the [[Fansite]] forums for GW)'s Lore Forum, specifically Scutilla, an user known for posting popularity contests between pairs of characters.
